history.prompt: matte clay 3D render, soft-body shapes, studio render with a neutral seamless backdrop. three or four simplified geometric forms stacked in a clear physical arrangement, with the top block slightly larger, single soft key light with gentle contact shadows, matte muted palette, no text.

Cut-paper editorial collage of two intersecting elements: a modular server blade and a layered invoice. Layered torn and cut shapes, halftone newsprint texture, printed-texture paper in muted teal and amber ink colours. Clean silhouette edges against a plain background. The two elements visibly interlock and oppose each other. Minimalist editorial composition, generous empty margin, no legible print.

Overhead flat-lay photograph of paper documents on a plain desk surface. Top-down 90-degree view, even diffused daylight. A simple rate notice or financial statement rests slightly out of alignment to look handled. Blank or illegibly cropped paper, muted paper tones, minimalist composition, shallow depth of field on the top page.

Cut-paper editorial collage, layered torn and cut shapes of a consumer billing invoice interlocking with a rising corporate growth chart, halftone newsprint texture. Two elements that visibly oppose and interlock, printed-texture paper in muted ink colours, clean silhouette edges against a plain background, no legible print.

style_when: the story is regulatory or contractual — a filing, a mandate, a rate notice, a certificate, a purchase order that changed the economics
prompt: overhead flat-lay photograph of paper documents on a plain desk surface, showing an amended billing statement and rate notice. top-down 90-degree view, even diffused daylight, one document slightly out of alignment to look handled, blank and illegibly cropped paper with muted paper tones, minimalist composition, a metal pen resting nearby.
negative_prompt: text, letters, numbers, wordmarks, signage, UI, logos, watermarks, recognizable brand names, messy background, people
rationale: The story hinges on a direct consumer cost increase and the changing economics of a subscription bill. A document flatlay of an amended rate notice captures the contractual shift and the sting of a compounding bill without needing literal logos.
subject: an amended billing statement on a plain desk
alt_text: An amended billing statement and rate notice resting slightly out of alignment on a plain desk surface.
caption: The latest round of streaming price hikes highlights how a stacked subscription model compounds costs for viewers.
title: streaming-rate-notice-flatlay
